analytics.name: Analytic 2055
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies wireless controller management log entries showing Service Set Identifier (SSID) or Media Access Control (MAC) address filter configuration changes for the Industrial Control System (ICS) wireless network from an account not in the authorized wireless admins. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.
